target: Z_k(A)=sum_{|I|=|J|=k,I intersect J empty} |det(A[I,J])|^2 for Gaussian-rational A and supplied k

claims.statement: The row/column measure and complement-site-cover measure satisfy [x^U](g_mu*g_nu)=Z_k(A) exactly.
claims.scope: All Gaussian-rational square A; all integer k; with out-of-range sectors interpreted as zero.

claims.statement: The selector polynomial product_i(x_ri+x_ci+x_ri*x_ci) is nonnegative, multiaffine, and log-concave on the positive orthant.
The row/column determinant-weight polynomial is not log-concave for A=[[0,1],[1,0]], n=2,k=1.
claims.scope: Falsifies this natural encoding as an application of Theorem 1.6; does not rule out alternate encodings.

claims.statement: The complete-site-pair selector x_1*x_2+x_3*x_4 is not log-concave, so the recorded Gram subset-convolution factorization also fails Theorem 1.6.
claims.scope: This specific Gram selector factorization only.

claims.statement: For nonzero row/column measure, log coefficient range is O(k(L+log(n+1))) bits for total rational input length L; the exact determinant oracle has polynomial bit cost.
claims.scope: If rank(A)>=k; rank(A)<k returns zero directly.

theorem_source_status: Chen-Liu arXiv:2610.06724v1 is source-reported; this leaf checks the target interface, not the full FPRAS proof.
not_established: No impossibility for other coefficient encodings.
No approximation-hardness result or complexity lower bound.
No general direct FPRAS for Z_k(A).
falsifier: A different exact encoding meeting the theorem's nonnegative multiaffine log-concavity, seed, range, zero-handling, and rational-bit requirements.
